items.source: Create a new instance of ArithmeticOperators.Integral for the value stored at the given field holding a numeric value.

items.source: Create a new instance of ArithmeticOperators.Integral for the value provided by the given expression that resolves to a numeric value.
items.translation: 为给定表达式提供的数值创建一个 ArithmeticOperators.Integral 的新实例，该表达式解析结果为数值。
